args: New local separation measurement only, at the unchanged achieved approach. Do not repeat rim fitting or demand a global bottle-top height certificate. The context projects a conservative carton plus finger-opening and upward-withdrawal envelope into both cameras. Identify the neighboring green bottle, not the carton or robot. Request b0,b1,b2 as agentview depth points and b3,b4,b5 as wrist depth points on exposed envelope-facing bottle surfaces and transitions immediately adjacent to the overlap. Choose interior depth-valid patches, not mixed silhouette pixels; they need not be corresponding landmarks. Provide up to two DIFFERENT spare interior pixels per camera if depth fails. For each view, supply a conservative convex polygon around the locally relevant bottle silhouette in perimeter order ONLY when its envelope-facing boundary is observable across the whole relevant band. The polygon may end outside that band; remote bottle extrema are not needed. support_edges are zero-based polygon-edge indices whose supporting line bounds the bottle on its far side throughout the band; never mark an artificial crop edge or a chord cutting into a curved silhouette. The program will require the entire projected assembly to lie within that edge's tangential span and will test a metric separating camera-ray plane with pixel and metric allowances. complete_local_boundary means no hidden section in that band could invalidate the observed local boundary; otherwise use surface_only or unknown and give the exact missing segment. Do not infer hidden clearance from a few depth points or from the robot occluding the bottle. If a polygon is supplied, its bottle depth samples should lie inside it. Check the same carton and upright bowl without requesting another rim reconstruction. other_external concerns only other bodies relevant to this local envelope, not all scene objects. Report contact only if observed. No motion or release is authorized by this review.

result.explanation: The wrist view exposes the neighboring dark green bottle behind and to the right of the Cream carton. Agentview provides no unambiguous exposed bottle patch. Neither view establishes the complete envelope-facing bottle boundary. No external contact is visible. This measurement-only review authorizes no motion or release.

parameters.notes: b0,b1,b2 are unavailable: the robot wrist/gripper obscures the bottle in agentview across the relevant projected envelope band, approximately y=300..423. No agentview spare is identifiable without risking a robot measurement. b3 samples exposed green surface above the carton; b4 and b5 sample the bottle strip immediately right of the carton. Interior patches require depth validation. Wrist spares are different interior pixels. In the wrist view, the envelope-facing bottle contour disappears behind the carton at its top edge near y=432 and remains hidden beside the carton below that edge; the visible right-hand strip does not reveal this hidden contour. The bowl hides the upper continuation near its lower-right arc, and the gripper hides the lower continuation. Thus no complete local polygon or supporting edge is supplied. Sparse exposed surfaces do not establish hidden separation. Other visible nearby bodies show local separation, not global clearance. The visible carton and upright patterned bowl are consistent with the supplied identities. Retention is supported by the supplied carton-hand co-motion record, not closed fingers. Earlier images are not present for independent visual comparison. No rim reconstruction or global bottle-top certificate is requested.
